title: Servicing Desk Basis Note: Moving the Monthly Due Day on an Auto Loan
content:
A borrower on a loan of the Auto Loans line may move the monthly due day to another day from 1 to 28.

**How far the day may move.** The new due day may differ from the current one by at most the largest move of the due day the product publishes, in calendar days, in either direction, counted within the month.

**What the loan must look like.** The loan must be active, with no installment past due.

**How often.** Every product allows the number of changes it publishes per rolling window of 365 calendar days. A change is allowed only when 365 calendar days have passed since the last change. Calendar days are counted with the day after the date of the last change as day 1, and a new change is allowed when the present date is on or after that date plus 365 days. Where there has been no earlier change, a change is allowed.

**What moves and what does not.** The next due date moves to the new day, in the month in which the loan's next installment already falls. Interest keeps accruing daily, so a later due day means more interest in that installment. The maturity date is not changed. No fee is charged for the move.

## Boundary cases on the rolling window

A loan whose last due day change was recorded on a given date is not eligible for another on the three hundred and sixty-fourth day counted from the day after that date. It is eligible on the three hundred and sixty-fifth day, and on every day after it. A loan that has never had its due day moved is eligible today.

## Where the evidence comes from

The date of the last change, the standing of the loan and the days past due are read from the bank's record of the loan, taken before the move is made, and correlated to the loan being moved. A date the borrower recalls does not settle the window.

## How far the day may travel

The published limit bounds the distance travelled, not the destination. A loan currently falling due on day 6 of the month may move as far as day 21 where the product publishes a largest move of 15 days, and as far back as day 1, the days from 1 to 28 being the whole range a due day may take.
